The [[Coorimbus system/Legends|Coorimbus system]] contained [[Coorimbus IV]]. It was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Calipsa Province]], near the [[Shifa system/Legends|Shifa system]].
